subject.title: [Feature]: Add realtime video frame transport for provider and gateway relay sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core/gateway relay video-frame transport for realtime voice sessions, or keep visual frames browser-direct/plugin-owned for now?
rationale: This crosses camera-derived data, gateway RPC, Plugin SDK, and provider-retention boundaries; automation can confirm the gap but cannot choose the product/security contract safely.

options.title: Hold for security/API design
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design item until maintainers approve the consent, payload, logging, provider-retention, and SDK/RPC contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow one-shot relay API
options.body: Allow a bounded JPEG frame RPC and bridge method with explicit capability gating, size/MIME validation, no ambient capture, redaction-safe logs, docs, and live provider proof.

options.title: Reject gateway frame transport
options.body: Keep frames browser-direct or provider/plugin-specific and close this design only after preserving the supported alternative for relay/native clients.

recommendation.title: Hold for security/API design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design item until maintainers approve the consent, payload, logging, provider-retention, and SDK/RPC contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned on the live issue and authored the unified Talk session runtime that owns the gateway-relay API boundary.
